verifier: blind Claude agent re-implementation from the brief only; comparison computed by compare_independent.py (agent verification, not human)
ambiguities: Team-game date/season/opponent taken from the first row of the (game_id, team_id) group; verified in data that each game has exactly one date and season and each team-game one opponent_team_id, so this is not consequential.
Team total t_min uses minutes with missing treated as 0 (as stated); appearance min uses raw minutes (> 0 by definition).
'State before d' for an entity = its last item (in (date, game_id) order) whose date < d; when an entity has several items on the same date earlier than d, the last of them in game_id order is used.
Row role uses the position of the same appearance used as the player state (latest appearance by (date, game_id) dated before d); missing or unmapped position (e.g. 'ATH', 'NA') -> X.

q = latest date among the player's appearances for T within T's prev (last 5) team-games; conflict resolution applied per (game_id, player) across all output team-games of the game: larger q wins, tie -> smaller team_id.
Player state always exists for output rows (candidates have an appearance strictly before d), so no player-state missingness handling was needed.
Recent R sums and window stats include the state appearance itself and the preceding appearances (last 10 / last 15 appearances up to and including the state item), across all teams/seasons.
Window mean computed as sum/n; window variance computed two-pass (sum of squared deviations from the mean)/(n-1).

Priors: phi per player uses pandas sample variance (ddof=1) over the player's appearances within the role subset; players counted with >= 10 appearances in that subset only. If the role subset is non-empty with positive minutes it is used for all prior quantities (rates, pcts, phi).

The general 'a/b with b <= 0 is missing' rule is applied to every division in section 8 (including divisions by L(...) and by priors-derived denominators); prior ratios (rate_x, pct_s, fg3_share) and team constants are plain divisions with no guard (denominators were never zero in practice).
psr_s_luck_pre = R_m / R_a - shrunk, missing when R_a = 0 (R_a can never be negative).
pr_pool_pre (and thus pr_exp_reb_pre) is missing when either T or O has no team-game before d (O missing is the stated case; T always has one).
pv_fg3a_exp_pre uses rel = 1 when pv_opp_fg3a_rel_pre is missing for any reason (O with no prior team-game, W(opp_fga) <= 0, or L <= 0).

Negative binomial pmf computed in log space: exp(gammaln(N+n) - gammaln(n) - gammaln(N+1) + n*log(p) + N*log(1-p)) with p = 2/3 and 1-p evaluated as 1 - 2/3; beta-binomial pmf likewise exp(log C(N,x) + betaln(x+a, N-x+b) - betaln(a,b)). For mu = 0, NB(0)=1 and others 0.
pc_p_gek_pre: for N < k-1 the inner sum runs over x = 0..N (full support), giving 1 - (sum of pmf) which is ~0 up to rounding (not forced to exactly 0).
Output team-games with season >= 2013 whose team has no prior team-game produce no candidates and therefore no rows.
Exponentially weighted sums computed by the exact recursion W_i = r*W_{i-1} + x_i with r = 0.5 ** (1/h) (vectorised across entities by within-entity position).
